title: Polish Quesadilla
description: A unique twist on traditional quesadillas, incorporating Polish flavors and crunchy texture.

ingredients.name: yeasty
ingredients.notes: yeast extract or active dry yeast

instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
In a bowl, mix together green, pepper, and yeast extract.
Lay a quesadilla flat and sprinkle a quarter of the green-pepper mixture onto half of the tortilla.
Fold the quesadilla in half and cook for 2-3 minutes, until the tortilla starts to crisp.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for another 2-3 minutes, until the other side is crispy and the filling is heated through.
Repeat with the remaining quesadillas and filling.
Cut the quesadillas into wedges and serve hot with a sprinkle of crunchy topping.
